display_name: LoRa W24 任务损失驱动的可学习回写幅度（Full）
description: Compare a learned uniform gain with observed per-chirp gains while the recovery direction and original E104 remain fixed.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 performance goal and user instruction to launch when memory permits.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI archived W24 and immutable release; local CPU independent truth-last collector.
code.cwd: Released archived W24 implementation directory; LoRa experiment files resolved from immutable new release.

data.representation: At fit 8192 complex points; at W24 readout 8 chirps × I/Q × (384 center + 48 native edge).
data.physical_ids_ref: Ordered source V physical IDs and archived blind RX order, 2000 target packets per receiver
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full clean and six practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: Frozen original E104 and previous legal G correction. Gain training uses L_s true CE, same-source synthetic pairs, and E104 high-confidence clean U_s pseudo CE. Inference uses only IQ-derived summary. No target, source V, hidden U_s labels or exact simulation channels in fit.

checkpoint.initialization: Shared pre-target source-selected strong-source G, itself at 40000 cumulative steps. Freeze all G tensors and E104. Initialize both new gain outputs at exactly 0.5. Reset AdamW for gain parameters.

sources.role: New G common source freeze and archival Full comparator.
Frozen first recovery and formal Full historical comparator.
Original E104 PAMF and fixed clean anchor; remains fixed in G-only CE row.
Fixed-step original loss U-Net common initialization.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact W24 E104 contract, source U-Net proof, L_s ID and ten class mapping, U_s metadata without y.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Parent designated by fixed source gate, selected before target access. No formal outcomes alter source fit or threshold.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze both arms at +6000. Only adaptive_gain can promote after same 300 Full source V packets. Six strictly higher than global gain and every archived comparison. Low urban strictly above global gain and at least stronger-source parent and other comparisons, clean at least direct and parent.

execution.gpu_policy: N607 preferred 7,2,0,3,6,5. At least 12 GiB free and fewer than eight existing compute contexts. Up to two training and three prediction workers, one new worker per physical GPU.
execution.stop_rule: Stop dependent stages on failed exact initial identity, incompatible source parent, illegal input roles, inactive permitted CE gradient, change to frozen parent/E104, nonfinite fit or missing frozen prediction. No formal when source gate misses.

metric_names: sampled waveform and clean training losses
strong source branch actual sampled exposures and nominal SNR range
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent source score then conditional local w24_joint_pamf collect after all Full shards are frozen.

rows.method: Task-trained global scale over frozen G
rows.seed_notes: 2026113003 shared fit draw and original generic RNG; 2026113004 strong Bernoulli and white augmentation. Existing Full source panel 2026112559.
rows.optimizer: AdamW gain LR 4e-4, cosine to 2e-6, weight decay 1e-4, clip 1; frozen backbone.
rows.budget_ref: 6000 gain-only updates after 40000 legal source parent steps, 96000 L_s plus 96000 U_s exposures per arm.

rows.method: Task-trained adaptive per-chirp scale over frozen G
rows.seed_notes: 2026113003 shared fit draw and original generic RNG; 2026113004 strong Bernoulli and white augmentation. Existing Full source panel 2026112559.
rows.optimizer: AdamW gain LR 4e-4, cosine to 2e-6, weight decay 1e-4, clip 1; frozen backbone.
rows.budget_ref: 6000 gain-only updates after 40000 legal source parent steps, 96000 L_s plus 96000 U_s exposures per arm.

notes: Both arms freeze original strong-source recovery parameters, keep their complex correction direction, and preserve native edges. They begin at exact 0.5 amplitude and bound gain to [0.05,0.95]. The learned comparison has one global scalar. The candidate adds a 32/16-hidden-width MLP using per-chirp outer dechirped spectral power, coherence, normalized native edge power, relative center RMS, and their eight-chirp averages.

Both arms use identical original generic draws and the preceding strong white replacement branch, one third, −8 to +4 dB. Both train through original E104 and lawful waveform losses, hiding U_s TX. No PAMF-based routing, scenario labels, test RX or test-derived threshold at deployment. Original E104 consumes a single recovered aperture.
Freeze both rows, repeat same source panel, test only a source-qualified adaptive variant on official Full and reuse frozen strong-source predictions as matched historical parent.
